title: XDOF, just three months out of stealth, is in talks for a Series B at a $1.2B valuation | TechCrunch
summary: The startup plans to hire and train teams of data collectors worldwide, including teleoperators who steer robots remotely and egocentric operators who wear body sensors to capture movement data. Marina Temkin is a venture capital and startups reporter at TechCrunch.
